resources.string: Browse and play from your HTTPS WebDAV server. Enable WebDAV on your NAS; SMB/NFS are not supported in this version. NAS connections bypass the app’s website HTTP/SOCKS proxy.

Credentials are encrypted with Android Keystore and excluded from backups. Use the same URL and passphrase on all devices. A lost passphrase cannot decrypt remote data. Requires Basic authentication and a valid HTTPS certificate.

Sync watch records, rules, selected settings, WebDAV positions, search aliases and translation history. Data is encrypted in this folder. Cookies, download paths and videos are excluded. Deletions propagate; resolve conflicts with a manual preview. Update every device to a version supporting search-data sync.

Confirmation publishes remotely and merges locally. Pause downloads first. A local recovery snapshot is created; changed data requires a new preview. Turning remote priority off keeps local values on conflicts.
Delete local credentials, sync baseline and network playback positions? Remote data and videos are kept.
Operation failed. Check the HTTPS URL, credentials, certificate, network, passphrase and storage. If remote publishing succeeded, preview again to retry. Sync requires server ETag support.
Access denied. Check the account, password and folder permissions.
Remote data changed and was not overwritten. Preview again.
Playback failed. Check the format, permissions and server range support.
Could not save playback position. Check available storage.
